title: Stockfish, But If It Can Sacrifice a Rook, It Must
summary: Normal chess vs a variant Stockfish (UI name 'GothamFish (3600)', a GothamChess/Levy-faced fish) that must sacrifice a rook whenever it can: if any legal rook move puts a rook en prise (where White can capture it), it must play one. Narrator treats it as ~+10 material, keeps lines closed early, trades other pieces, collects the sacrificed rooks while avoiding recapture tricks, and wins.
rules: Bot rule: if the bot has any legal move that sacrifices a rook (a rook move to a square where it can be captured, e.g. Rxa2 into a recapture), it must play one (choosing the best such move by eval); otherwise it plays normal Stockfish moves.
Definition of 'sacrifice' = rook moves to a square attacked by White [inferred].
